body_long:
Rome hosted the independent side of luxury hospitality last week. From 19 to 21 November 2026, The Leading Hotels of the World held its 60th Annual Convention in the city, under the theme "The Art of Independence". More than 400 owners, general managers and industry leaders took part in three days of talks and visits.

## Six Roman addresses, one gala at Caracalla

The programme was spread across six member hotels: Anantara Palazzo Naiadi on Piazza della Repubblica, Hassler Roma at the top of the Spanish Steps, Hotel Splendide Royal, Baglioni Regina, Portrait Roma and Villa Agrippina, a Gran Meliá hotel. The gala dinner took place at the Baths of Caracalla.

Shannon Knapp, president and chief executive of the group, opened the event on a clear message: "independence has become one of luxury's greatest differentiators". Speakers came from McKinsey & Company, Eurasia Group and the Luxury Communications Council, alongside Roman makers from Maison Balestra and Corto Moltedo.

## The 2026 Leading Hotels Membership Awards

Eight hotels and hoteliers were honoured at Caracalla. Marcel P. van Aelst, vice chairman of Okura Nikko Hotel Management, received the Leading Legend award. Peter MacCann, general manager of The Merrion in Dublin, won Uncommon Vision. Hôtel Royal at Evian Resort was named Member of the Year, and The Silo Hotel in Cape Town New Member of the Year.

The other winners were Argos in Cappadocia (Remarkable Experiences), Borgo Egnazia in Puglia (Change-Makers), Acqualina Resort & Residences in Florida (Unrivaled Luxury Leader) and Nayara Tented Camp in Costa Rica (Sustainability Leader).

The 2027 convention will take place in Amsterdam next November, across The Okura, De L'Europe and The Dylan.

## The signal

As large groups multiply their luxury brands, independent hotels are making their difference a selling point. A shared network gives them the reach of a group while keeping their own name over the door.

Congratulations to all the winners, and to the Roman teams who hosted the convention.
summary: More than 400 independent hoteliers met in Rome from 19 to 21 November for the 60th LHW convention; Hôtel Royal Evian was named Member of the Year.
